messages:
Priya: heads up — crazy crosswind on the bridge, almost lost my umbrella and my coffee ☕️ :wind_face:  
Ari: ugh same. I had to hold onto the bus pole like my life depended on it. Muni 22 slow as molasses.  
Sam: anyone else saw a seagull dive-bomb a commuter? it literally snatched a latte from a lady at Embarcadero  
Jordan: wait WHAT. seagulls are evolving into baristas now.  
Maya: @Priya which bridge? thinking of rerouting — I usually take 280 -> 19th exit.  
Priya: Richmond-SF bridge side ramp, heading in around 08:10. traffic at a crawl toward downtown.  
TransitBot: BART ALERT — "signal problem at Embarcadero" causing 15–25m delays inbound. https://www.bart.gov/schedules/status  
Ari: confirmed, inbound was sitting between Montgomery and Embarcadero for a while. if you can, delay departure by 20–30m.  
Sam: poll: who’s going into office despite the wind?  
Priya: (raises hand) I’m already parked and will brave it.  
Jordan: WFH today. not risking a seagull ambush and soggy shoes.  
Maya: still commuting but switching to bike + rain jacket. anyone have rec for a sturdier umbrella? lost two this winter :sob:  
Ari: Headsup: if you bike, watch the painted crosswalks — slick AF. also saw a small tree branch down near 3rd & Folsom.  
Priya: thanks — I’ll take the longer route. also lol @Sam’s seagull theory. video or it didn’t happen :eyes:  
Sam: attaching 10s clip in thread — seagull steal.mp4 (posted in thread)  
TransitBot: Ferry service — on time but expect choppy ride.  
Jordan: pro tip: if you’re near Caltrain, check the app. express trains are packed so consider local.  
Maya: ok team status: 3 commuting, 2 WFH, 1 late to decide. stay safe y’all. :heart:  
Priya: if anyone needs a ride from Embarcadero to SoMa around 9:15, I have one seat.  
Ari: I’ll take it if still open. thanks!  
Priya: confirmed — see you at the Embarcadero entrance by the big clock.  
Sam: seagull: 1, humans: 0. will narrate my next commute like a nature doc for morale.
